test_title: PYST 45: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : XTR :: LHF : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : XTR :: LHF : %

Option 1) # = DTX, % = FBZ → DTX : XTR :: LHF : FBZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/173462e547f7354a8bd0e4ab28a9b519f72e737304163c0b8aa06b87944bfbdc.png] 

Option 2) # = DZX, % = FBO → DZX : XTR :: LHF : FBO

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18077bfb8108f6c51f3aad991d3d8632feb08190076622df59b3d269dfc2466f.png] 

Option 3) # = DZX, % = FBZ → DZX : XTR :: LHF : FBZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79702d6362a71b0859c9f755c67ce78b31e111d2d3ce414b4112683d9196ddcb.png] 

Option 4) # = UZX, % = FBZ → UZX : XTR :: LHF : FBZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0eabf341857e26ab33870ba603581b347a9543e463fb9635160c580c55e34a78.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
